class.name: TestMapView
class.brief_description: Shows the debug test map: a ground plane and its blocked cells as boxes.
class.description: Reads the shared grid [code]testmap.grid[/code] from the simulation snapshot and rebuilds its ground and its obstacle MultiMesh only when the map is a different one from before. Emits [signal map_changed] so the camera can set its bounds.

method.name: get_map_size
method.description: Returns the map's extent in meters (width, depth), or zero before a map has been seen.

method.name: get_obstacle_count
method.description: Returns how many blocked cells are drawn.

members.member: Where the [CitySim] node is. The default is the one inside the [code]Sim[/code] autoload.

signal.name: map_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the view was rebuilt for a new map, with the map's extent in meters.
